description: This Java class 'DirectoryEntryAdapter' is an adapter for a RecyclerView, providing views for directory entries, including file name, MIME type, and icon based on whether the entry is a directory or a file.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for RecyclerView to display directory entries with icons and text.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: Custom ViewHolder class holding references to views for filename, MIME type, and icon.

methods.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of directory entries.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder object for a directory item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a DirectoryEntry to the ViewHolder, setting text and icon based on MIME type.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of directory entries.

methods.name: setDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Updates the list of directory entries in the adapter.
